elements.title: World Gem-Quality Natural Diamond Mine Production and Reserves
elements.content:
| Country           | Mine production 2022 | Mine production 2023e | Reserves                                   |
|-------------------|----------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| United States     | —                    | —                    | World reserves of diamond-bearing deposits are substantial. |
| Angola           | 7,890                | 7,900                | No reserves data were available for other gemstones. |
| Botswana         | 17,100               | 17,000               |                                            |
| Brazil           | 158                  | 160                  |                                            |

| Congo (Kinshasa) | 1,980                | 2,000                |                                            |
| Guinea           | 103                  | 100                  |                                            |
| Lesotho          | 728                  | 730                  |                                            |
| Namibia          | 2,050                | 2,000                |                                            |
| Russia           | 23,500               | 24,000               |                                            |
| Sierra Leone     | 551                  | 550                  |                                            |
| South Africa     | 3,860                | 3,800                |                                            |
| Tanzania         | 319                  | 320                  |                                            |
| Zimbabwe         | 446                  | 440                  |                                            |
| Other countries  | 302                  | 300                  |                                            |
| World total (rounded) | 75,200           | 74,000               |                                            |
elements.notes:
eEstimated. — Zero.
